title: Offline Study Assistant — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Provides downloaded notes and local study tools without internet. The Offline Study Assistant provides access to downloaded notes and supported local tools without internet. Before going offline, the student syncs their notes, flashcards, and guides; offline, the assistant serves them all locally — search, quizzes, and summaries run on the device. When the connection returns, progress syncs back up.
capabilities: Sync notes and decks before going offline
